result.reason: The clause meets or exceeds the stated limits: statutory workers’ compensation, CGL at $1M per occurrence/$2M aggregate, and a combined professional/E&O and cyber policy at $5M, with evidence available on request. However, it goes materially beyond the playbook by adding insurer-rating requirements, additional-insured status, waiver of subrogation, primary/non-contributory coverage, cancellation notice, and a non-limitation-of-liability provision. It also requires $5M cyber coverage regardless of whether Contractor processes Customer Data and raises E&O to $5M rather than the preferred $2M. Drafting is cumbersome and ambiguous regarding which policies the endorsements and notice requirements apply to, and the notice provisions are duplicative.
